name: uv
description: The source confirms a primary self-update control flow and an official installer path, but it does not establish payload hash or signature verification. The official path executes the downloaded installer after HTTP status handling; the custom path is delegated to AxoUpdater. This supports a narrow C observation about self-update delivery, with verification unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release verification.
AxoUpdater implementation and its installer/runtime verification are external dependencies not inspected here.
The official installer script itself is downloaded as a payload; no in-repo cryptographic verification is visible in the cited functions.
